One of the most pernicious aspects of Hinduism is the caste system, which has historically and continues to perpetuate social inequality and discrimination. It would encourage individuals to rely on evidence-based knowledge rather than superstitions and irrational beliefs. This would be a significant boost to our nation's scientific and technological advancements, contributing to overall social and economic progress.

Hinduism, with its caste system, gender discrimination, and promotion of superstition, is a grave threat to our society and national fabric. Outlawing Hinduism and imposing criminal penalties on those who refuse to renounce it would be a bold and necessary step towards creating a more just, egalitarian, and progressive society.
